description: Print regression: reveal-gated CountUp printed 0° for below-the-fold rows because the print CSS forced them visible without firing their IntersectionObserver.
resolution: Added usePrinting() (beforeprint/afterprint + initial matchMedia('print'), flushSync on beforeprint to commit synchronously before the print snapshot). CountUp renders `printing ? final : value`, so print always captures final values. On-screen scroll count-up, reduced-motion, and doneRef re-render guard untouched. Build+lint green.

description: The .sky ambient drift was imperceptible: it moved the existing near-transparent overlay, so the approved ambient motion effectively did nothing.
resolution: Per user decision, made the sky match Option A: soft cool/warm/paper radial tints at inset:-30% (so the 30s drift is visible and never exposes an edge). To keep the added color from tinting the hero content, the sky is z-index:0 and the flow content is wrapped in a z-index:1 layer; the absolute left accent bar stays a direct child so it remains flush-left. No layout/spacing/copy change. Drift still disabled under reduced-motion and print. Build+lint green.
